pages.title: CC:Tweaked basics
text: CC:Tweaked is optional and installed separately. Most machines are peripherals that expose measurements and actuators, never judgements. Put a computer beside a machine, or join them with wired modems, then list what it sees:
The reactor is a bwr_reactor. Use your own names, not the examples'. Every machine peripheral has getName(), setName(), getPort() and setPort(). A panel can read a machine by its CC port (0 to 9999).

pages.title: Commands, and the house rule
text: A program can set rods and flow, open and close valves, start pumps and call scram. Rod ids start at 1 and notches are 0 to 48:
The house rule holds for programs too: nothing the mod does acts on its own, so every trip, pump start and load shed is a program you write. A program that exits leaves its commands in force.

pages.title: The example programs
text: Six examples are in the docs/lua folder of the repository. They are not part of the mod and nothing installs them: startup.lua (one recirculation and rod manoeuvre), backup_scram.lua (scrams on limits you give it), eccs_start.lua (starts one named emergency pump), containment_isolation.lua (closes named valves), panel_display.lua (draws a reactor summary on a graphic display) and spds.lua (a plant computer program).
Copy them into an examples folder on an in-game computer. Each file's header lists its arguments, and they need named targets. Read docs/lua/README.md first.
